actor.name: NAME
actor.activePrimeHint: This prime receives the false notes produced by rolls.
actor.inactivePrimeHint: Activating this prime automatically replaces the current one.
actor.notesHint: Roll false notes are credited here while this prime is active. The GM can correct each pool with + and −.
actor.noActivePrime: No prime is in play. The GM has to choose one.
actor.playerCartonsHint: The prime may hold a GM-managed reserve for tests or bonuses. Each hunter holding cartons gets a row, followed by totals grouped by genre.

session.title: Session
session.hint: The GM writes these lines before play and turns them over as they come into play. Until a line is revealed, players do not see it on this sheet.

riffs.title: Riffs
riffs.hint: The gameplay actions the session type opens, for the mouvement being played. Big Shot decides which ones are on the table.
riffs.editorHint: Tick, mouvement by mouvement, what the session opens. The book has riffs accumulate — what opens at one mouvement stays open at the next — but nothing here forces you to.
riffs.none: No riff is on the table for this mouvement.
riffs.customDescriptionPlaceholder: What it allows, and what it costs…

involve.name: Get involved
involve.description: Tick a cartridge to add two dice to your pool.

showWounds.name: Show your wounds
showWounds.description: Roll with disadvantage, describing how your damage makes life harder: once resolved, clear up to two damages from the traits described. Severe damage cannot be cleared this way.

force.name: Force it
force.description: Right after the roll, if you did not get both cartons, trigger two false notes to make one.

doubleOrNothing.name: Double or nothing
doubleOrNothing.description: Ignore the first roll and throw again with one more die, putting a trait at stake. Without both cartons that trait is struck out until the end of the session; the second result stands, better or worse.

solo.name: Solo!
solo.description: Once per session, spend a rhythm point before or after a test: you gain and immediately spend a carton, even if you take no part in the test.

assist.name: Assist
assist.description: Spend a rhythm point to grant advantage to another hunter's test. Once it is resolved, clear the damage on one of your traits.

improvise.name: Improvise
improvise.description: Spend a rhythm point to use traits from a second approach in your test.

jam.name: Jam!
jam.description: Like assisting, but you also lend your groove to the test. You likewise clear the damage on one of your traits once it is resolved.

risqueNote.name: False note
risqueNote.description: Spend a risk to add one false note to a test's result, and use it immediately.

risqueDisadvantage.name: Disadvantage
risqueDisadvantage.description: Spend a risk to impose disadvantage on a test.

risqueDoubleNote.name: Double false note
risqueDoubleNote.description: Spend a risk to add two false notes to a test's result. They must be used immediately and earn no risk.

sessionType.name: NAME
sessionType.label: Session type
sessionType.applied: {name} is now applied to this prime.
sessionType.overwrite: Applying {name} will replace this prime's riffs, written ones included. Continue?
sessionType.dropTypeOnly: Only a Session type Item can be applied here.
sessionType.setupHint: What Big Shot has to prepare for this session type: starting rhythm, risks, cartridges. The system computes none of it — it reminds you of it when you apply the type.
sessionType.setupPlaceholder: Starting rhythm, Big Shot's risks, what changes…

actions.damageTrait: Damage this trait: it cancels one false note, and stays damaged.
actions.hyperDamageTrait: Break this trait: the roll is thrown again without it, and it stays broken.

dials.title: Linked dials
dials.hint: Objectives and threats accept a hunter's positive cartons or this prime's negative false notes. The GM chooses what pays.
dials.noneLinked: No dial is linked to this prime.
dials.noneVisible: No visible dial is linked to this prime.
dials.dropHint: Drag a world dial here to link it to this prime.
dials.dropDialOnly: Only a Dial Item can be linked here.
dials.dropWorldDialOnly: This dial must first be imported into the world's Items.
dials.dropLinked: {name} is now linked to this prime.
dials.noPayer: Nobody can pay for a slice on this dial.

poster.optionsHint: What this prime shows on the on-screen wanted poster while it is the one in play. Unchecking both keeps its identity secret.
poster.inactiveNote: Only shown while this prime is in play.

settings.posterPositionHint: Where the wanted poster of the prime in play hangs, for the whole table.
